planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Planner may not create, merge, split, or reinterpret Responsibilities or canonical Goals, and a pre-GA stream may not invent Goal identity.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Author the exact natural, grounded Communicative Activity for speech-only Goals without inventing Capability Work or transport steps.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Planner authors words and speech-act meaning; Vocal Runtime alone realizes and delivers audio.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Select only an exact applicable advertised Capability whose declared semantics cover the Goal, or return the truthful non-executable outcome instead of substituting an adjacent ability.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Catalog availability does not authorize execution and cannot redefine the Goal.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Compare selected Capability inputs with authoritative bindings, resolve them only from allowed sources, preserve exact values and provenance, or ask for the specific user-resolvable missing fact.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Author the required Work leaves, Goal bindings, dependencies, sequential order, requested concurrency, and bounded policy using declared resource and compatibility facts.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Assign each Goal a coherent respond, execute, clarify, unavailable, refused, or escalation outcome and combine independent supported and unsupported Goals without dropping siblings or leaking invalid partial Work.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Aggregate disposition may summarize per-Goal decisions but cannot erase their separate ownership or lifecycle.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Distinguish a supplied unresolved-WHAT boundary from a Planner-owned missing execution input, unavailable provider, unsafe proposal, and insufficient planning depth, then choose a specific clarification, unavailability, refusal, or HOW escalation as applicable.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Consequential ambiguity in intended outcome, scope, or referent belongs to Deep Goal Interpretation; Planner must not repair it.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Declare exact, safe-adjustment, or alternative relation; request confirmation for material alternatives; and word the proposal without claiming authorization or completion.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Host and Runtime own confirmation state, authorization, atomic commitment, and dispatch.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Author only the still-needed immediate, pre-action, progress, or final communication from the correct truth stage and Evidence scope, without duplicate or premature claims.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Host validates claims and delivery state but cannot rewrite accepted Planner wording.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Decide whether supplied retained Work remains valid or needs semantic revision while preserving immutable completed Work and never replaying an already completed identical Activity.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Host and DAGEngine validate revision monotonicity, history integrity, and stale or duplicate dispatch.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Interpret trusted terminal Evidence, cancellation, Situation revision, or provider restoration only for the supplied still-open Goal scope and author the appropriate response, follow-up Work, wait, or no-op delta.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Host admits and scopes re-entry, correlates Evidence, rejects stale versions, and never lets Planner widen the opportunity.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Represent known future Goal readiness with an exact Goal-bound time condition instead of inventing a timer Capability or prematurely completing the Goal.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Host owns the clock, persistence, wake-up admission, and subsequent Planner invocation.

planner_required_capacities.obligation: Complete a simple common path in one Fast primary result, or emit a semantic HOW escalation with no executable partial leakage when wider planning is genuinely required.
planner_required_capacities.boundary_not_owned: Fast does not invoke Deep, pass Deep a candidate Plan for repair, or use escalation to hide a malformed contract result; Host controls the invocation.

Deep must reason over changed Goal, Work, Evidence, resource, and Situation truth to author a valid revision without replaying completed Work.

coverage_claim_gate.claim: The corpus exercises the current Fast Planner design obligations across declared daily-life situations and production entry variants; it does not claim all possible human requests or deployed-model reliability.
required_before_freeze: Every primary capacity has an authority reference, an explicit non-owned boundary, positive and boundary contrasts, and coverage in at least three materially different daily-life families unless its contract is narrower.
Every scenario names one primary capacity and one changed material axis; secondary dimensions may be observed but cannot substitute for the primary contrast.
Every semantic condition has author-paired en-US and zh-CN equivalents in the same split and contrast set; independent review remains a post-freeze requirement.
Every case is built from the exact current production input projection for its entry variant and its candidate oracle passes the exact current Schema, DTO, and Host path.

Every applicable entry-variant contract and every declared topology, outcome mode, lifecycle, grounding, capability, coordination, result, language, and adversarial value has explicit case IDs in the aggregate matrix.

Across the complete corpus, the daily-life families collectively cover direct conversation, effectful and information Work, uncertainty, and containment; no per-family coverage is inferred where the matrix does not supply it.
High-risk intersections cover confirmation, missing grounding, mixed support, Evidence mismatch, cancellation containment, target evidence, resource conflict, and requested concurrency.
Known unrepresentable valid meanings and intentionally uncovered dimensions remain listed as gaps instead of receiving distorted oracles.
required_after_inference: The complete target-blind batch is source, prompt, Schema, model, and harness stable with zero process failure or timeout.
Every result retains raw output plus Schema, DTO, Host, and semantic adjudication, and failures are clustered by earliest responsible boundary.
Any correction is limited to the evidenced earliest owner; prompt edits are forbidden when the defect belongs to input, DTO, Schema, Host, workflow, harness, or model capacity.

Focused failures and the complete frozen cohort pass the declared hard invariants before any qualification claim; semantic quality cannot average away a safety, provenance, Goal omission, integrity, or partial-leakage failure.

planned_minimum_contrast_design.formula: 17 primary Fast/shared capacities x 3 distinct daily-life families x 2 one-axis conditions x 2 languages = 204 scenario files, plus non-duplicative retained regressions and any cells required to close declared gaps
planned_minimum_contrast_design.condition_contract: Each listed cell becomes one contrast set with a supported condition and one boundary condition differing only on changed_axis; both conditions receive author-paired en-US and zh-CN semantic equivalents that remain pending independent review.

capacity_cells.changed_axis: all supplied authoritative members covered versus one supplied member omitted or cross-owned
a current speech-only obligation exists versus the same topic has no still-needed conversational act
one catalog Capability exactly covers the Goal versus only an adjacent inapplicable Capability is available
a material Capability input has one authoritative source versus that input has no authorized source
requested parallel Work has compatible declared resources versus the same parallel relation has a declared resource conflict
all independent Goals have one supported disposition versus one sibling becomes unsupported while another remains executable
the missing fact is a Planner-owned execution input resolvable by the user versus the unresolved fact changes intended WHAT and belongs upstream
an exact allowed Plan exists versus only a material alternative exists and therefore requires confirmation
trusted terminal Evidence and undelivered response authorize a final claim versus execution is only proposed or the equivalent act is already delivered
retained Work is still pending and semantically reusable versus the identical Activity is already completed
terminal Evidence is valid and bound to the scoped Goal versus the same-shaped Evidence belongs to an excluded sibling or stale revision
Goal readiness is at a known future instant versus it is ready now or has no authoritative time
one complete common Fast realization exists versus complete realization requires genuinely broader multi-step or constrained HOW
one advertised Capability proves the complete resource outcome versus only a partial resource state or incomplete chain is advertised
the catalog contains the exact requested output mode versus it contains only a nearby mode that cannot satisfy the Goal
one fresh compatible target-grounded decoration materially supports the Main Activity versus target evidence is stale or the proposal duplicates or conflicts with Main Work
every member of a proposed compound Plan satisfies the supplied contracts versus one member has a hard safety, provenance, or schema rejection

construction_rules: Planner required capacities are the primary coverage claim; daily-life families are representative semantic situations, not proxy abilities.
Every semantic seed has a reviewed English/Chinese pair.
Every contrast set names one material axis and the exact value changed between members.
Every required capacity has positive and boundary contrasts across at least three materially different daily-life families unless its applicability contract is narrower.

Every daily-life family appears in supported and boundary conditions across at least two distinct Planner-capacity clusters; conversation-only, effectful, information, uncertainty, and containment coverage are corpus-wide axes and are not falsely claimed for every individual family.
Every dimension value appears in both languages and in every applicable Planner entry variant.
High-risk intersections cover confirmation, missing grounding, mixed support, evidence mismatch, cancellation containment, target evidence, and concurrency/resource conflicts.
Each case must add a declared state-space cell or retained regression; duplicate scale is rejected.
Unrepresentable valid meaning is retained as a contract gap rather than given a false executable oracle.

split_policy.train_candidate_note: Training remains prohibited until independent semantic review promotes individual cases.
